speaker.basis: settled 2026-10-02 from fresh-translation review: Generic Firebug mercenary in an Axio Burglar; addresses Beck, Gates, Kan Yu by name so is none of them; 姫 = the late Princess (Marilyn). Same as Jigoku (no pilot)

15:34.en: 「I'll knock you out of the sky!」
alternatives: I'll smash you into the ground!

15:172.en: 「This is how $$ファイヤバグ$$ does things!」

15:207.en: 「We'll do this the $$ファイヤバグ$$ way!」

15:238.en: 「You'll learn the power of $$ファイヤバグ$$!」

15:275.en: 「Remember $$ファイヤバグ$$'s name in terror!」

15:370.en: 「I decide whether you live or die!」

15:428.en: 「Run and I'll shoot you in the back!」

15:461.en: 「I don't care if you even exist!」

15:637.en: 「I'll show you why mercs are feared!」

15:715.en: 「This Burglar is an extension of us!」

15:855.en: 「I'll hit you in the power core!」
alternatives: I'll hit the power unit dead-on!
I'll hit your power unit directly!

15:1025.en: 「I won't let up until you go down!」

15:1169.en: 「I'll end the legend of the Gundam!」

15:1208.en: 「Is every last one of you a Gundam?!」

15:1549.en: 「Rely on that armor and you'll pay!」

15:1831.en: 「You're coming at me at that size?!」

15:2012.en: 「Take down the leader, and it's over!」

15:2192.en: 「Sorry, but that kill mark is mine!」

15:2306.en: 「Damn it! You used me as a shield!」

15:2477.en: 「What?! I can only watch them go?!」

15:2592.en: 「Damn it! Are you toying with me?!」

15:3033.en: 「Tch...! You made me use my barrier!」

15:3237.en: 「I don't even need to dodge that!」

15:3305.en: 「At least try to slow me down!」

15:3488.en: 「You've got some nerve to mock me!」

15:3810.en: 「So the Gundam isn't just for show!」

15:4202.en: 「This is bad... Death is calling me.」

15:4485.en: 「I gave this life to the Princess!」

15:4675.en: 「Damn it!\nWhat the hell did they do?!」

15:4930.en: 「I've sunk as low as I can go...!」

15:4998.en: 「Now I'll just go as far as I can!」

15:5142.en: 「Even fallen, we're still $$ファイヤバグ$$!」

15:5177.en: 「Make $$ファイヤバグ$$'s power known again!」

15:5220.en: 「$$ファイヤバグ$$ isn't dead yet!」

15:5261.en: 「$$ファイヤバグ$$'s name\nmust never fade!」

15:5411.en: 「We bet our lives on her last words!」

15:5518.en: 「$$ソレスタルビーイング$$!\nBack again?!」

15:5958.en: 「You fraud! I won't buy your spiel!」

15:6147.en: 「The Princess taught us eye for eye!」

15:6178.en: 「Letting you go\nwould shame $$ファイヤバグ$$!」

15:6285.en: 「I'll clean up your mess, $$カン・ユー$$!」

15:6353.en: 「$$ゲイツ$$! Don't shoot me in the back!」

15:6465.en: 「Too bad! Now it's one on one!」

15:6770.en: 「Try it a hundred times, same result.」

15:7062.en: 「Damn! I can't get our morale up!」

15:7138.en: 「$$ミスリル$$...! Better than the rumors!」

15:7327.en: 「It'll eat me! That beast'll eat me!」

alternatives: Running won't do you any good!
